text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both grinding higher with modest gains, while altcoins show mixed momentum—a sign of selective strength rather than broad conviction. The Fear & Greed Index at 34 reflects persistent caution, and the sharp 20-point drop over the week suggests sentiment is cooling despite price stability. Bitcoin's dominance holding firm at 59.3% on $73B daily volume indicates capital is consolidating around the majors rather than rotating into riskier alternatives.
